honestGap: runtime-state.json is a fixture invented for this proto; no editor flow or daemon route emits this schema yet. The ReviewState machine itself (10 states, 21 transitions) is NOT invented — it is a 1:1 port of lib/dispatch/state-machine.ts + lib/dispatch/queue.ts's DispatchState union, which is what core/pd-console/src/dispatch_pane.rs and conductor_pane.rs already render as strings.
verification: tests/self_capture.rs (`cargo test --release -- --ignored self_capture`) drives the compiled binary as a subprocess, renders the same fixture headlessly, and asserts the PNG exists, decodes to the expected dimensions, and has more than one distinct pixel color. Must be --release: fontique's CoreText font enumeration (objc2-foundation 0.2.2's Swift-bridged NSFastEnumeration shim) panics in debug builds with an ABI-width mismatch unrelated to this crate's own code — a genuine upstream quirk, documented in the test's doc comment.
